title: pvMergeVectorComponents
body:
## pvMergeVectorComponents

Combines three single-component arrays of the same association (e.g. Ux, Uy, Uz from a solver that writes components separately) into one 3-component vector array named OutputVectorName; the dataset is otherwise unchanged. Use it before operations that need a vector field, such as glyphs, stream tracing or vorticity.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The three arrays must have the same association (AttributeType, for example "Point Data" or "Cell Data") and one component each.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `MergeVectorComponents`. Identity: `filters/MergeVectorComponents`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AttributeType` | Association of the three component arrays and of the merged vector array. Chosen by the ParaView entry text: "Point Data", "Cell Data", "Vertex Data", "Edge Data" or "Row Data". ParaView offers only the associations the connected input has (for example "Row Data" for a table), so a text it does not offer fails with NATIVE_DOMAIN_MISMATCH when the node is configured. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Point Data","Cell Data","Vertex Data","Edge Data","Row Data"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Point Data"` |
| `OutputVectorName` | This property contains the name for the output vector containing the result of the merging. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `XArray` | This property indicates the name of the array with the X component. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `YArray` | This property indicates the name of the array with the Y component. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ZArray` | This property indicates the name of the array with the Z component. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvMergeVectorComponents",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
